    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AizawaDemoView
    3D MDI demo view for the Aizawa attractor.
    AizawaDemoViewInfo
    View information for the Aizawa Attractor Demo.
    AizawaEquations
    Implements the six-parameter Aizawa attractor as a system of three first-order ordinary differential equations.
    AizawaModel
    Numerical model for the five-parameter Aizawa attractor.
    AizawaPhasePlotPanel
    2D phase plot panel for the Aizawa attractor demo.
    AizawaSimulation
    Simulation wrapper for the Aizawa attractor demo.
    AizawaSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of the Aizawa attractor state for rendering and diagnostics.
    Axes3D
    A composite set of three Cartesian Axis3D children (x, y, and z), built from either explicit axis limits or a [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax] array.
    Axis3D
    A single Cartesian axis: a Line3D from vmin to vmax along one of the Axis3D.AxisType directions, with major tick marks (added as Line3D children) and a lazily-created TextRenderer for the axis label and per-tick value labels.
    Axis3D.AxisType
    possible types of axes
    Bad3DPropertyException
    Thrown by Item3D's typed property accessors (get, getString, getColor, getFont, getInt, getFloat) when a requested property is missing or is not of the requested type.
    ControlPanel
    Control panel for the kinetics demo.
    Cube
    A solid, axis-aligned cube, optionally framed and optionally rendered with Phong-style per-face lighting.
    Cylinder
    A solid cylindrical tube between two endpoints, with a fixed radius, optional extension beyond its defining endpoints, and optional Phong-style lighting.
    DemoApp3D
    Demo application for the MDI framework.
    DrawingDemoView
    An ordinary 2D drawing view, included in the MDI-3D demo application specifically to demonstrate that 2D and 3D MDI views coexist in the same application.
    DrawingDemoViewInfo
    View information for the 2D Drawing View included in the MDI-3D demo.
    EntropyPlotPanel
    An sPlot-based entropy-vs-time strip chart for the kinetics demo, built from a single connected Curve that new points are appended to as the simulation runs.
    GeometrySlice3DView
    Companion MDI-3D view for the 2D geometry slice demo.
    GeometrySlice3DViewInfo
    View information for the Geometry Slice 3D view.
    GlobeCountryLines3D
    Draws country outlines on a sphere as 3D polyline strips.
    GlobeView3D
    A lightweight, interactive 3D globe view.
    GlobeView3DInfo
    View information for the 3D Globe view.
    Item3D
    Base class for every drawable object hosted on a Panel3D.
    KeyAdapter3D
    Shared static logic for MDI-3D's fixed keyboard/legend commands: pan (L/R/U/D), dolly (J/K), incremental rotation (X/Y/Z, tripled when shifted), and four canonical axis-aligned views (1-4).
    KeyBindings3D
    Installs the standard MDI-3D keyboard bindings on a Panel3D via Swing's InputMap/ActionMap, so they work regardless of which child component currently has keyboard focus within the panel's focused window (unlike a plain KeyListener, which only fires when the panel itself has focus).
    KeyboardLabel
    This is for making a label to show what a key stroke does, e.g., R for move right
    KineticsDemoView
    3D kinetic-gas demo hosted in the MDI simulation framework.
    KineticsDemoViewInfo
    View information for the Kinetics Demo.
    KineticsModel
    A physics model simulating particles in a 3D box with elastic collisions.
    KineticsSimulation
    Simulation wrapper for the kinetic-gas demo.
    LabelSet3D
    Draws screen-space text labels for a set of 3D points.
    LabelSet3D.LabelCull
    Functional interface for optional per-label visibility tests.
    Line3D
    A single straight line segment between two endpoints in world coordinates.
    LogoDemoView
    3D MDI demo view: a lit, continuously rotating recreation of the MDI logo.
    LogoDemoViewInfo
    View information for the MDI Logo Demo.
    LogoSimulation
    Simulation wrapper for the rotating MDI-logo demo.
    MouseAdapter3D
    Standard mouse interaction for a Panel3D: drag-to-rotate, and wheel-to-zoom.
    Panel3D
    Swing component that hosts a JOGL GLJPanel and manages a simple interactive 3D scene.
    Panel3DDemo
    A standalone, minimal JFrame that hosts a bare Panel3D with a handful of sample Item3D shapes and a KeyboardLabel showing the active key bindings.
    Particle
    Simple record to represent a particle's position in 3D space.
    PlainView3D
    Base class for simple 3D MDI views backed by a Panel3D.
    PointSet3D
    A set of same-color, same-size points, drawn as either square or circular point sprites.
    PolyLine3D
    A 3D polyline item represented by an ordered list of vertices.
    Quad3D
    A single filled (and optionally framed) quadrilateral, defined by four corner vertices in world coordinates.
    ScatterPlot3D
    A thread-safe 3D scatter plot for use on a Panel3D.

    Callback fired on the EDT whenever the bounding box grows.
    ScatterPlot3D.RenderStyle
    Rendering styles for the data markers.
    ScatterPlot3DDemo
    Demonstration of ScatterPlot3D.
    ScatterPlot3DDemoInfo
    View information for the ScatterPlot3D Demo.
    SimulationSnapshot<T>
    Optimized snapshot containing raw coordinates for OpenGL.
    SimulationView3D
    Base class for an MDI 3D view that hosts a SimulationEngine.

    Factory for creating a simulation control panel component.

    Factory for creating an optional diagnostics/settings component (e.g.
    Sphere
    A solid sphere, optionally with drawn latitude/longitude gridlines and optional Phong-style lighting.
    Support3D
    A stateless library of OpenGL drawing primitives for the MDI 3D framework.
    TextRendering3D
    Utility for rendering crisp, screen-space text associated with 3D world positions in an MDI-3D Panel3D.
    TextRendering3D.Anchor
    Anchor point used to place text relative to its projected pixel position.
    TextRendering3D.Style
    Immutable drawing style for one text pass.
    Trajectory3D
    A dynamic 3D trajectory item that grows by appending points over time.
    Triangle3D
    A single filled (and optionally framed) triangle, defined by three vertices in world coordinates.
    Vector3f
    A minimal, mutable single-precision 3D vector with the handful of operations (length, dot, cross, normalize, midpoint) that the mdi3D geometry helpers need.
